answer: The three words are derived from a 78 bit value mixing the epoch seed with the identity key, so no two keys ever receive the same triple. Because the oasis nonce is published only after close, the knoll audit can verify each derivation and a shared text is provable as copied. That removes the entire premise of a template farm, which depends on one text serving many identities, and forces a separate lagoon derivation per key. That is 3 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
